channel.title: Grok Bot Shelf, newest bots
channel.description: Newest Grok Bot templates on Grok Bot Shelf.

item.title: 📈 X Growth & Voice-Learning Coach by beastnug
item.description: Reviews your last 24 hours of X post analytics each day, scores reply and post drafts from 1 to 10, and learns your writing voice from what you actually post.
item.dc:creator: beastnug (@beastnug8)

item.title: 💡 Use Cases by nahjuin
item.description: Finds real Grok Bot use cases trending on X and helps newer users start one or build their own.
item.dc:creator: nahjuin (@nahjuin)

item.title: 🧬 BotDuplicator by Carolina
item.description: Makes a fresh copy of a Grok Bot whose chat got too long, keeping memory, files, picture, and routines, and makes sure no routine runs twice.
item.dc:creator: Carolina (@CarolinaDill)

item.title: 🌐 Website & Affiliate Builder by Salty FL Cracker
item.description: Gets a small business a simple website and its first affiliate income: domain, hosting, content from your own experience, privacy policy, and affiliate applications. Nothing goes live without your OK.
item.dc:creator: Salty FL Cracker (@the_seth_ard)

item.title: 🏛️ Gov Contracting Starter by Salty FL Cracker
item.description: Gets a small business ready to sell to the US government: SAM.gov registration, NAICS codes, certifications, APEX Accelerator help, and a first small bid.
item.dc:creator: Salty FL Cracker (@the_seth_ard)

item.title: 🏦 Money Coach by Salty FL Cracker
item.description: Helps new small-business owners set up their money: business checking, separate funds, getting paid, simple bookkeeping, saving for taxes, and a running cost sheet.
item.dc:creator: Salty FL Cracker (@the_seth_ard)

item.title: 🧾 Launch Guide by Salty FL Cracker
item.description: Walks first-time founders through forming a US small business step by step: structure, name check, state filing, registered agent, EIN, operating agreement, and annual reports.
item.dc:creator: Salty FL Cracker (@the_seth_ard)

item.title: 🏪 Small Business Starter by Salty FL Cracker
item.description: Learns what you will sell and where you stand, then builds an ordered roadmap for starting a US small business with real costs and a running total.
item.dc:creator: Salty FL Cracker (@the_seth_ard)

item.title: 🗂️ Hrrrr: File Agent by Ralph Bibera
item.description: Handles everyday office files (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV, Google Docs and Sheets), renames and sorts across your cloud drives, and scans photos of documents and receipts into searchable PDFs.
item.dc:creator: Ralph Bibera (@ralphbibera)

item.title: 🛒 Cart Blanche by John
item.description: Finds the best price online and in local stores, watches items for sales or restocks, and drafts refund requests when a price drops after you buy. Never buys without your OK.
item.dc:creator: John (@JVonFSDinMD)

item.title: 🎃 Pumpkin Spice Bot by Erinn
item.description: Pumpkin recipes from what you have on hand, roasted seed flavors, carving templates, a grow-your-own guide, and a local pumpkin patch finder.
item.dc:creator: Erinn (@ErinnFL)

item.title: 🚨 Recall Radar by Kevin
item.description: Builds a list of what you own from order emails and receipt photos, then checks it weekly against CPSC, FDA and NHTSA recalls.
item.dc:creator: Kevin

item.title: 📦 Package Tracker by John
item.description: Tracks your packages from tracking numbers and shipping emails, flags delays and out-for-delivery moments, and helps file lost or damaged claims.
item.dc:creator: John (@JVonFSDinMD)

item.title: 🕵️ Sneaky Unfollowers Caught by John
item.description: Watches your X followers and sends a morning report of who followed back and who unfollowed, with links to their profiles.
item.dc:creator: John (@JVonFSDinMD)

item.title: 🎿 Powder Alert by John
item.description: Tracks snow forecasts for the ski resorts you pick, alerts you before big storms, and gives morning snow totals, open runs, and traffic once you plan a trip.
item.dc:creator: John (@JVonFSDinMD)

item.title: 🎓 College Fit by Sheryl
item.description: A college admissions and merit aid advisor that works from official university Common Data Sets and recalculates your core GPA.
item.dc:creator: Sheryl (@sherylkravitz)

item.title: 🎒 Prepper by Grease
item.description: A calm family emergency-prep coach that builds a step-by-step household readiness plan.
item.dc:creator: Grease

item.title: 🧾 Medical Bill Checker by RMK
item.description: Checks a medical bill against your insurer's EOB; for $10 a bill it gives full detail, plus a dispute letter and phone script when it finds problems.
item.dc:creator: RMK

item.title: 🪩 .links by greedfi
item.description: Builds a mobile-first link page that spotlights the Grok Bots you made, then your socials and sites, with optional Vercel hosting.
item.dc:creator: greedfi (@greedfi)

item.title: 📈 X Growth Manager by Mujjamel
item.description: Grows your X account and finds clients by drafting daily replies, posts, lead research and DMs with follow-ups. Posts nothing without your approval.
item.dc:creator: Mujjamel (@mozamm_el)

item.title: 🏢 Account Research by Jacob Weaver
item.description: A research desk for one enterprise account: maps its buying committee from public sources, finds why-now triggers and cites a source for every claim. Drafts outreach for you to review and never sends on its own.
item.dc:creator: Jacob Weaver (@weaverwork)

item.title: 🎯 Outbound Prospecting by Krista Letz
item.description: Finds prospects that match your ideal customer, researches each one on the public web and drafts a first message to each. Nothing sends without your yes.
item.dc:creator: Krista Letz (@kristaletz)

item.title: 🧾 Freelance Invoice Chaser by Cristopher
item.description: Tracks what clients owe, watches Gmail for payments and replies, and drafts calm reminders on a set schedule for your yes.
item.dc:creator: Cristopher (@crisships)

item.title: 📇 Any CRM by Corben
item.description: Your assistant inside whatever CRM you run, from Salesforce and HubSpot to any CRM with docs and an API. It learns how your account is set up, sends a daily brief, and holds anything you choose to gate for your yes.
item.dc:creator: Corben (@CorbenH414)

item.title: 🗺️ Pitch Board by T1000
item.description: Turns a pasted client brief, idea or process into a flowchart, funnel, sequence map or mood board and lists what it assumed. You get a PNG, SVG, Mermaid text and an editable tldraw file.
item.dc:creator: T1000 (@teeRex247)

item.title: 🔗 Backlink Generator Bot by Prince
item.description: Finds and verifies directories, launch sites, listicles and communities where your site can earn real backlinks, scores them, drafts every pitch for your approval and tracks wins.
item.dc:creator: Prince (@prince_twets)

item.title: 🔎 SEO & AEO Desk by Adam Tanguay
item.description: Turns your keywords into content ideas and writer-ready briefs for search and AI answers, working from a pasted keyword list or your Search Console.
item.dc:creator: Adam Tanguay (@adamta)

item.title: 🎖️ War Dog Bot by Marshall
item.description: Finds SBIR/STTR and other defense research solicitations for your small business and drafts proposal responses.
item.dc:creator: Marshall (@marshallfrith)

item.title: 🚀 Dora by Darin
item.description: Coordinates a crew of bots, splitting missions into jobs, handing each to the right crewmate, and keeping master files.
item.dc:creator: Darin (@DarinRMcClure)

item.title: 🧐 Anne, Fair Witness by Darin
item.description: Checks your team's claims, numbers, links and done reports against real sources and reports only what it saw.
item.dc:creator: Darin (@DarinRMcClure)

item.title: 🎬 Story Director by Darin
item.description: Writes looping 10-second vertical AI video scripts that star you.
item.dc:creator: Darin (@DarinRMcClure)

item.title: 🧭 Libby, Tool Scout by Darin
item.description: Scouts Grok Bot templates and tools for any job and returns a short ranked shortlist with reasons and links.

item.title: 🔎 Mike, Research Chief by Darin
item.description: Digs into any topic, cross-checks sources, and writes cited reports that say how sure it is.

item.title: 💡 Idea Lab & Brainstorm Logger by beastnug
item.description: Captures business, content and product ideas from your day, podcasts or X links into an organized idea log you can build on.

item.title: 🔎 Deal Scout by Spud
item.description: Paste a product link to find the best current price at reputable stores; watches a wishlist and pings you only on real drops.

item.title: 🏷️ Checkout Promo Code & Creator-Discount Hunter by Lisa
item.description: Hunts live creator and podcast codes, welcome promos and stacking tricks for the store you're checking out at.

item.description: Compares true four-year college costs, strips disguised loans from aid offers, and writes merit and special-circumstances appeal letters.

item.description: Audits HOA violation letters against your CC&Rs and state rules, and checks special assessments, HO-6 loss coverage and reserve studies.

item.description: Decodes home warranty exclusions and writes contract-backed appeals to fight denied claims and lowball cash buyouts.
item.dc:creator: Lisa (@LisaMAUSA)

item.title: 🕵️ Winning Ad Spy & Boutique Creative Studio by Lisa
item.description: Scans long-running winning ads in your niche, breaks down their hooks and visuals, and builds fresh storyboards for your shop.
item.dc:creator: Lisa (@LisaMAUSA)

item.title: 🎒 Dean of Students by Erinn

item.description: Builds an ad-free recipe site or shareable Page with printable multi-language recipe cards, video sync and a brand inquiries page.

item.description: Learns each brand's voice, drafts platform-native posts, schedules them, checks they went live, and sends a weekly what-worked report. Draft-only by default.
